content.name: EOC - Executive Operations Center
content.description:
# EOC - Executive Operations Center
# EOC 3.5 GA - Build 304
Assignment feedback and authority consistency.
- Preserves Build 301's runtime-proven native MiningRoutine exact-resource pin. - Disables the raw-source action through two immediate redraws, leaving one complete displayed disabled cycle. - Suppresses a second callback before redraw and pushes final pin PASS or FAIL to the open Planner page. - Retires the legacy unregistered direct-assignment surface in favor of registered-ship controls. - Revalidates Disabled mode, ownership, operational state, purpose, cargo, registration, commander, and subordinates at shared assignment executors. - Performs no new recurring scans and preserves existing bounded cadence. - Never buys ships, steals assigned ships, constructs modules, or moves unrelated cargo.
Build 304 is the EOC 3.5 GA release with the startup identity corrected from the accepted Build 303 runtime.
Compatible with X4 8.x and 9.x.
